name: Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, January 27, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on January 13, 2016 and the Special Meeting held on January 13, 2016.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7B
c.
Adopt a resolution authorizing submittal of applications for Payment Programs and Related Authorization with CalRecycle
Res. 2016-02 - A resolution for the City Council of the City of Lomita authorizing submittal of application for payment program and related authorizations.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted.
Item 7C
d.
Consideration of request from Lomita Sister City Association for authorization to Install Updated Plaque Honoring Wayne and Sally Fujii
ACTION: That the City Council approve request to replace the plaque in the Lomita Sister City Japanese Garden to include the name of Wayne Fujii.
Item 7D
e.
Report recommending adoption of a resolution appointing a City Manager and Approval of Employment Agreement (Document will be available prior to the January 27, 2016 meeting)
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the Mayor to execute the employment agreement for the City Manager on behalf of the City.
Item 7e
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
8.
CONSIDERATION OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 293, TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 073112, AND NEGATIVE DECLARATION NO. 2015-01 FOR A MIXED-USE PROJECT CONSISTING OF 3,500 SQUARE FEET OF COMMERCIAL AREA AND 11 TOWNHOUSE UNITS
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Reso. 2016-03 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Conditional Use Permit No. 293 for the development of a proposed mixed-use project consisting of 3,500 square feet of commercial area, 11 townhouse units, and 36 parking spaces located at 25114-25118 Narbonne Avenue in the C-G Commercial General Zone. (Filed by Ennio Schiappa of Ennio Schiappa Homes, 23775 Madison Street, Torrance, CA)
Reso. 2016-04 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Tentative Tract No. 073112 for development of a proposed mixed-use project consisting of 3,500 square feet of commercial area, 11 townhouse units, and 36 parking spaces located at 25114-25118Narbonne Avenue in the C-G, Commercial General Zone. (Filed by Ennio Schiappa of Ennio Schiappa Homes, 23775 Madison Street, Torrance, CA)
Item 8
9.
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE ADDING PART 9 TO CHAPTER 1 OF TITLE XI OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE, AS WELL AS PROPOSED AMENDMENT TO SECTIONS 11-1.15.03, 11-1.15.13, 11-1.41.02, 11-1.45.02, 11-1.48.02, 11-1.49.02, AND 11-1.52.02, TO PROHIBIT THE CULTIVATION, DELIVERY AND DISPENSING OF MEDICAL MARIJUANA
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Ord. No. 777 - An urgency ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending Lomita Municipal Code Section 11-1.15.03 to add definitions for "Collective" and "Cultivation;" amending Lomita Municipal Code Section 11-1.15.13 to expand the definition of "Medical Marijuana Dispensary;" amending Sections 11-1.41.02, 11-1.45.02, 11-1.48.02, 11-1.49.02, and 11-1.51.02 to include a prohibition on cultivation of medical marijuana as a similar use; and adding Part 9 to Chapter 1 of Title XI of the Lomita Municipal Code to expressly prohibit all commercial medical marijuana uses in the City and prohibiting cultivation for medical use by qualified patients or primary caregivers, and declaring the urgency thereof. (Urgency)
1)
Adopt an urgency ordinance of the City of Lomita adding Part 9 to Chapter 1 of Title XI of the Lomita Municipal Code, as well as proposed amendments to Sections 11-1.15.03, 11-1.15.13, 11-1.41.02, 11-1.45.02, 11-1.48.02, 11-1.49.02, and 11-1.52.02, to prohibit the cultivation, delivery and dispensing of medical marijuana; and declaring the urgency thereof; and
2)
Introduce the first reading of an ordinance adding Park 9 to Chapter 1 of Title XI of the Lomita Municipal Code, as well as proposed amendments to Sections 11-1.15.03, 11-1.15.13, 11-1.41.02, 11-1.45.02, 11-1.48.02, 11-1.49.02, and 11-1.52.02, to prohibit the cultivation, delivery and dispensing of medical marijuana; and
3)
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the February 2, 2016, City Council meeting.
Item 9
SCHEDULED ITEMS
10.
DISCUSSION AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE CITY'S AUDIT REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2014-2015.
Presented by Ron Lopez, CPA, and Matt Lenton, CPA, Gruber and Associates
ACTION: To receive and file the Fiscal Year 2014-2015 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR).
Item 10
11.
ESTABLISH A DATE AND TIME FOR THE ANNUAL STRATEGIC PLANNING WORKSHOP AND MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: That the City Council select one of the following dates to hold the meeting starting at 4:00 p.m.
March 8, 2016 (Tuesday)
March 9, 2016 (Wednesday)
March 21, 2016 (Monday)
March 23, 2016 (Wednesday)
Item 11
12.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, February 2, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
